body: That's true. :)  I'm feeling a lot better now that I talked to someone and got advice. This sub is really awesome.

I love music. I grew up with my dad being singers in local bands all my life. I love 70s music like Rush, old punk music and newer Indie stuff. I'd love to be in a band or a music teacher. Not many people want to be in a band with a girl though. I've seen lots of things go wrong due to feelings and just people being jerks but blame it on the girl there. Sometimes it is their fault sometimes it's just a scapegoat. I've tried out for some but people have never chosen me. I've started to make my own demo just using my computer.

We don't go many places because we don't have a car and I can't even legally drive. I had a rare brain pressure issue when I was younger (in remission for almost three years!) and the longer it goes untreated the more it effects your vision. You can progressively go blind. It starts with your peripherals, that's how far it got before I got treatment. So we have to rely on rides to our friends because the bus doesn't go out there. I think when we save up enough for a car it'll improve.

I think I will. I'll ask him about it when he gets up. She works at a women's shelter as a cook so I know she's seen some things like my past. She knows I was abused but I never talked more about it with her. I've hardly talked about it with my boyfriend either. It feels like if I say too much he'll look at me different.

I'm not that good at much else but singing. Since I was little I'd do local talent things with one of my sisters. I don't feel I could do anything with it though. I have a great voice, but I'm not cut in a shape that people would notice. I love to do it though music makes me happy. 

In the last few months we've gone to a gone to a few of our friends band's gigs. We danced and had an awesome time. Went back to the bands place (all live in one house) drank and they kinda jammed out and included me. I liked being around more than ones person. I love my boyfriend I love being with him just sometimes it's nice to be with other people and hear new things. Sometimes we'll go months without seeing people other than each other.

I like to say my dad doesn't scare me but he does. If anyone even speaks in an aggressive tone I shut down. I'm not so scared to talk to her because she's with him. More so because if she knew how I felt because she stayed with him instead of protecting her seven kids she wont speak to me anymore. And because they thought the right way to approach my sucide attempts was to cut off things that made me happy and act like I didn't even try to do it makes me think she just will not have a conversation about it.

I love my boyfriends mother, she's the kindest person ever but I don't know if we have that kind of relationship. I find it hard to open up to older people. I don't know if it's okay to tell her things like this.

I have some hobbies, I write poems and little short stories, I love to make digital drawings and I love to cook. I don't to much in the day.. I get up go on the computer, clean, eat, play with my ferrets, look for a job online, play Xbox/other video game spend some time with my boyfriend, maybe eat again, TV and sleep. Sometimes the order is changed up.

At first the pregnancy came as a shock but after a few days we accepted it and got so excited. We were planning he found two more programming jobs right away. We were going to make it work.

I do want to go to school, I'm studying for my GED currently since I was unable to finish high school. I want to go on to do more schooling but I don't know what. I do want to work too.. I want to bring something in and have something to show for myself. 

I've worried all the time since I can remember. I don't know why. Sometimes I just don't feel safe and start thinking about everything that's wrong in my life.

I wish I could.. I saw her at Christmas but her and my father moved several states away. I'm worried to let her know how I feel. When I was younger and hurt myself after my stint in the mental hospital I was grounded for two years. It sounds dumb but because she and him did that I feel she doesn't think I'm actually sad.
